llm.focus: Backend / data infrastructure: Node.js, ingestion pipelines, ClickHouse, Snowflake, Postgres, third-party integrations. Pay special attention to idempotency and duplicate events, retries and timeouts, partial failure mid-batch, ordering assumptions, null / missing / oversized inputs, multi-tenant isolation, schema migrations and backfills, authorization at resource boundaries, secrets handling, and unbounded queries or memory.

semgrep.command: semgrep scan --config p/javascript --config p/typescript --config p/nodejsscan --config p/sql-injection --config p/secrets --sarif --quiet --baseline-commit {base}
